title: An order form your plant customers can finish
text:
Show the expected answer inside the field, such as the pot size in centimetres, so customers fill it in right the first time.
A vague hint like 'your size' leaves people guessing, and many give up.
Group the fields that belong together under a short heading, such as delivery details, so the eye finds them quickly.
Put the shop's logo in the top corner of the page, where visitors expect to find it.
A logo floating in the middle of the menu pushes the links aside and looks like an advert.
Light grey text on white is hard to read on a phone in the sun; use dark text on a light background.
The text of the delivery promise matters most, so it should be the easiest line to read.
